title: Stringfield's investigations into crash retrievals

tellings.quote: there's a guy named string Feld who did a huge uh you know number of Investigations into it

plain: A man named Stringfield is said to have carried out a huge number of investigations into crash retrievals, the claim that crashed craft of non-human origin have been secretly recovered. The journalist Michael Shellenberger mentions this in passing while talking with Michels. He names Stringfield as a source on the subject but says nothing on the show about what those investigations found.
